title: Strategies for Integrating Disparate Social Information

participants.population: United States Amazon Mechanical Turk workers
eligibility: at least 95% prior MTurk approval rate

design.type: within-participant repeated visual estimation and belief revision

conditions.HF: high variance with peers clustered far from the participant
conditions.HC: high variance with peers clustered close to the participant
conditions.filler: additional distributions outside the focal 2-by-skew comparisons

main_task: Show a deterministic animal image for six seconds in the human interface.
Collect an independent first estimate from 1 through 150.
Use the published round-by-estimate lookup to show three prerecorded MTurk estimates.
Collect a second estimate from 1 through 150 without accuracy feedback.
four_peer_control: Do not show an image or elicit a personal first estimate.
Sample one valid prerecorded anchor from the published round-specific pool.
Use the published lookup to add three more estimates.
Collect one estimate integrating the four displayed estimates.
procedure.block_order: The two included blocks are randomized for each simulated participant.
procedure.feedback: No accuracy feedback is shown between rounds.

payment.selection: One round per original task block was randomly selected for payment.

model_calls.main_task: two per round: visual first estimate and text-only revision
